title: Normalized Koszul and Roos comparison data
statement: On an essentially small ringed site, use the actual principal Koszul complexes, principal-power quotient ring sheaves, total sheaf tensor, and strict Roos cone functor of the cited definitions. Package a derived-limit functor with its normalized Roos comparison, scalar-extension models with their ordinary and derived adjunctions, augmentations and localized tensor comparisons, a signed tensor/Roos interchange, and coordinate deletion maps as Models. Normalization states their universal properties, exact products and termwise derived-product calculation, unit and K-flat normalizations, signed component formulas, finite-tail quasi-isomorphism and naturality, and conservativity of derived restriction. Define the projection, comparison and strict-family maps as the displayed composites. Compatibility extends Normalization by their isomorphism, projection, constant-diagonal, adjoint, coefficient-transition, naturality and uniform-bound identities. Conclusion asserts the existence of such compatible data. All data is actual existing sheaf tensor, Koszul and Roos data, not placeholder constructions.
